path_only_control.non_vacuity: The control reads no line, so its 0 is structural and carries no evidence: at base it returned 0 on the same stale record where the line-bound arm returned 2. It therefore demonstrates the round-78 rule's blindness, not the claim. It also cannot be laundered as the claim's receipt: its own checks carry null ranges and empty digests, and --validate rejects it with 10 defects. The claim's counter is the line-bound arm, whose five matched checks carry 1-based ranges and digests that recompute from the live bytes.

findings.kind: frozen record / predicate, not instrument logic
findings.summary: The frozen R79-C2 counting command omits --battery. Executed verbatim it exits 2 with the usage line and writes no receipt, so the predicate's literal command cannot exit 0 (landing) or 1 (base) as written.
evidence: claims.json R79-C2 counting_command and predicate have no --battery
verbatim run: exit 2, usage, no file written
with --battery appended: freeze exit 0 5/5/0/0, base exit 1 3/5/2/0, both byte-identical in counts and checks to the frozen receipts
freeze-audit-at-freeze.json records round-79 clean with required_failed [], so the freeze gate did not catch the non-runnable command; executing it would have exited 2
findings.effect: The measured semantic content of R79-C2 reproduces exactly; the frozen sentence is not re-runnable as written. Repair: add --battery to the plan, the claims.json counting_command+predicate and the instrument's PREDICATE constant (which is copied into every receipt), then re-pin the instrument hash and re-freeze.

findings.summary: Duplicate declarations collapse silently: pin cells are last-wins (parse_record dict comprehension), while the Ghidra pointer/value and the .bashrc pointer are first-wins. A stale duplicate can therefore be dropped before it is compared.
evidence: fixture f-e2e-duplicate-masking: stale first OMP cell dropped, receipt ok true
record probe: 3 pin pairs, 1 Ghidra pointer but 2 application.version values, 6 .bashrc pointers — the frozen record's scoped cells are single, so its counts stand
findings.effect: Not triggered by the frozen record; a future record carrying a second, divergent declaration would bind only one and still report checks_total 5. A uniqueness assertion per cell family would close it.

findings.summary: Tokens are substring tests, so a live value that merely contains the declared token passes (rea-agents@6.7.05 vs 6.7.0; application.version=12.1.40 vs 12.1.4).
evidence: fixtures g-substring-pin and g-substring-version both matched
findings.effect: The claim's literal wording ('each declared token to occur there') is satisfied; version-boundary drift such as a 6.7.0-rc or 12.1.40 value would pass. Exact token-boundary matching would strengthen a future claim.

findings.summary: bind()'s line_count parameter is dead (every call passes 0; EOF uses len(lines)); lines arrive through text-mode readlines with errors='replace', so the digest is over decoded, newline-normalised text rather than raw file bytes.
evidence: all five live digests recompute equal from the pointed lines (LF files, UTF-8)
findings.effect: No effect on these five checks; a CRLF or non-UTF-8 config would hash a normalised line. Removing the dead parameter and reading bytes would make the digest a raw-byte claim.

residual_risks: The instrument's input is the live filesystem; the receipt's checked_at cannot be tied cryptographically to those bytes. My re-run at a later clock reproduces every digest, so the files did not drift in the interval, but a future reader can only re-check against the then-live files.

--validate proves internal re-derivation only; its own selftest accepts a forged receipt whose digests are arbitrary ('green-forged-consistent'). Live recomputation (done here, 5/5) is what makes the digest a claim about bytes.
The record carries six .bashrc pointers and two application.version values; only the declared scoped cell of each is checked (see F2).
verification_gaps: Cannot prove the landing run used --battery; only that adding it reproduces the receipt exactly.
The freeze-gate audit was not re-run by this seat (out of scope); its recorded result at the freeze is clean 29 with required_failed [].
